# NovaTools (toolboxs.tech)

> NovaTools is a 100% client-side, privacy-first media, document, video, audio, and architectural diagram processing suite. All processing executes locally inside the user's browser using WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, WebCodecs, HTML5 Canvas, and neural on-device AI. Zero files are ever uploaded to remote servers.

## Core Capabilities & Suites

- [PDF Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/pdf): Merge, Split & Extract, Rotate, AES Password Protect, Redact & Flatten, PDF to Images, Images to PDF, Page Numberer & Stamper, PDF to DOCX, and Word to PDF.
- [Image Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/image): AI Background Remover, Format Converter (WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG, ICO), Smart Compressor with real-time visual diff, Resizer, EXIF Metadata Scrubber, and SVG Optimizer.
- [Video & Audio Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/video): Video Compressor, Trimmer & Cutter, Audio Extractor, Video Muter, AI Subtitle Generator (Whisper ASR in 100+ languages), Audio Volume Booster (+12dB with limiter), Video to GIF Maker, Animated Lyrics Video Generator, and AI Voice Studio (Kokoro-82M TTS with human expressions).
- [Document & AI Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/document): Universal Document Studio, Markdown to PDF, Markdown to Word (DOCX), Document to Slides (PPTX), Document to Excel (XLSX), and Word to PDF.
- [Diagram & Visualizer Suite](https://toolboxs.tech/diagram): AI Document-to-Diagram Studio, Document to Flowchart, Document to Database ERD, and Document to Architecture Map.
- [SVG Tools](https://toolboxs.tech/svg): AST-based SVG optimization and 1-click React/JSX component export.

## Privacy & Security Architecture

- **Zero Server Uploads**: File binaries are held exclusively in local RAM (`ArrayBuffer`) and never cross the network.
- **Hardware Acceleration**: Computation executes across local CPU/GPU cores using WebGPU, WebCodecs, and multithreaded WASM.
- **Offline Sovereignty**: Tools work without an active internet connection once loaded in the browser.
